body:
## Goal

Add vertical-plane mirror support to pattern folders so users can program one half of a symmetrical part and mirror its toolpaths to the other half with full model verification. Depends on the CL toolpath transforms, pattern folder, and pattern verification sub-issues of `#2938`.

## Scope

- **Mirror mode (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`, commands, MCP, project file):** Add `Mirror { plane_point, plane_normal, cut_direction, keep_original }` to `PatternDef`.
  - Allow vertical planes only (`nz == 0`); refuse horizontal or tilted mirror planes at command creation.
  - Add `MirrorCutDirection` with `PreserveClimb` (default) and `GeometricMirror`.
  - Support `keep_original` (default `true`, matching copies `0` and `1`; copy `0` can also be disabled via `disabled_instances`).
- **Transform and posting (`crates/cl/src/cl/transform.rs`, `crates/app/src/posting.rs`):**
  - Under `GeometricMirror`, reflect moves, flip `arc.ccw` (`G2` <-> `G3`), and swap `CompSide` (`G41` <-> `G42`).
  - Under `PreserveClimb`, use safe per-pass reversal for 2D contours, profiles, and chamfers, and refuse by name any operation with ramps, adaptive clearing, or multi-pass roughing that cannot reverse safely.
  - Refuse unsupported operation kinds (turning, threading, probing, wire EDM, sinker EDM, tilted 5-axis moves) by name.
- **Full model verification (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`):**
  - Carve the mirrored copy into the stock simulation and judge it against the full part mesh (`deviate`).
  - Run live model gouge, shank, and rapid-in-stock verification (`crates/sim/src/verify/`, `crates/app/src/operation/kept_rejudge.rs`) and fixture checks on every mirrored toolpath so sub-lattice gouges and shank hits on the mirrored side block the post.

## Done means

Tests mirror a symmetrical pocket and contour part across an X or Y vertical plane, verify `PreserveClimb` keeps climb direction on 2D contours and refuses unsafe multi-pass reversal by name, verify `GeometricMirror` flips `G2`/`G3` and `G41`/`G42` in golden NC output, and prove that a gouge on the mirrored side blocks the post.

Part of #2938
